F1 · selection.records 只接受非空字符串 id，整数自增主键无法按记录授权

NocoBase3 内核 · @nocobase/authorization · @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization · @nocobase/db · 原评审：未解决

⌄

parseRecordSelection 要求 records 的每个 id 都是非空字符串；authorizer.compileConstraints 把 records 直接交给 idsScope，而 idsScope 对每个 id 生成 condition(primaryKey,'$eq',id)。当 collection 主键为整数（本应用 documents.id 为 increments）时：传数字会在写入前抛 TypeError('Invalid record selection')；把数字转成字符串虽能通过选择校验，却会在查询时被 Repository 的过滤器类型校验以 INVALID_FILTER（integer 字段不接受 string 值，HTTP 500）拒绝。authorization 的 db 子包又明确注释 FilterOperator 无 $in。因此框架的 records 记录选择与其自身的整数自增主键能力无法组合。

实际影响
按记录共享/限制的最直观路径对整数主键 collection 不可用；照 Skill 指引使用会得到 500 而非授权，Agent 需读源码后自造 record access 才能完成单条授权，增加排查与实现成本。
建议改法
让 parseRecordSelection/selection.records 接受数字 id，或在编译 selection 时按目标主键字段类型归一化值；为无法表达的 selection 提供写入期校验与明确诊断（而不是查询期 500）；并为 FilterOperator 增加 $in。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
对整数自增主键 collection 创建 sharing/restriction 规则，selection 使用 selection.records([id])
应有能力 / 行为
规则可写入，并按该记录 id 精确授权/限制
实际观察
数字 id 在写入时抛 TypeError: Invalid record selection；字符串 id 通过校验但查询时触发 RepositoryError: Filter value is invalid for Field "id" of type "integer"（HTTP 500）
应用绕行与代价
应用定义自定义 record access（library.sharedDocument）从 params 解析出数字 id 并返回 condition('id','$eq',number) 条件
改进后的验收标准
对 increments 与 uuid 两类主键，selection.records 均能创建规则且只命中目标记录，且无需应用自造 record access

packages/@nocobase/authorization/dist/core/selection.js:1–24E1

selection 构造器与 parseRecordSelection；records 分支要求每个 id typeof 'string' && id !== ''，否则抛 TypeError('Invalid record selection')，即整数 id 无法表达。

export const selection = {
    all: () => ({ type: 'all' }),
    records: (ids) => ({ type: 'records', ids: [...ids] }),
    recordAccess: (key, params) => params === undefined
        ? { type: 'recordAccess', key }
        : { type: 'recordAccess', key, params: structuredClone(params) },
};
/** Validates an untrusted value, returning it as a detached selection. */
export function parseRecordSelection(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)) {
        const type = Reflect.get(value, 'type');
        if (type === 'all')
            return selection.all();
        const ids = Reflect.get(value, 'ids');
        if (type === 'records' &&
            Array.isArray(ids) &&
            ids.every((id) => typeof id === 'string' && id !== ''))
            return selection.records(ids);
        const key = Reflect.get(value, 'key');
        if (type === 'recordAccess' && typeof key === 'string' && key)
            return selection.recordAccess(key, Reflect.get(value, 'params'));
    }
    throw new TypeError('Invalid record selection');
}

resolveEffectiveScope 以 anyScope 合并正向分支、allScopes 与限制取交集；compileConstraints 将 records selection 直接交给 idsScope(primaryKey, selection.ids)。

    async resolveEffectiveScope(principal, resource, action, configs, constraints, requestedFields) {
        // Each grant keeps its own fields and role filters through scope evaluation.
        const branches = await Promise.all(configs.map(async (config) => {
            const positive = await this.compileScopes(principal, resource, action, config.recordAccess ?? []);
            positive.push(...(await this.compileConstraints([...constraints, ...(config.branchConstraints ?? [])].filter((item) => item.effect === 'expand'), principal, resource, action)));
            const branchRestrictions = await this.compileConstraints((config.branchConstraints ?? []).filter((item) => item.effect === 'restrict'), principal, resource, action);
            return {
                config,
                configured: positive.length > 0,
                scope: allScopes([anyScope(positive), ...branchRestrictions]),
            };
        }));
        const restrictions = await this.compileConstraints(constraints.filter((item) => item.effect === 'restrict'), principal, resource, action);
        const fields = resolveDatabaseFields(configs, action);
        const requested = {
            ...requestedFields,
            ...(action === 'read'
                ? { output: resolveActionFields(action, fields, resource) }
                : { input: resolveActionFields(action, fields, resource) }),
        };
        const required = [
            anyScope(branches.map((branch) => branch.scope)),
        ];
        for (const direction of [
            'input',
            'output',
            'filter',
            'sort',
            'group',
        ]) {
            for (const field of requested[direction] ?? []) {
                if (branches.every((branch) => databaseFieldsAllowed({ [direction]: [field] }, resolveDatabaseFields([branch.config], action))))
                    continue;
                required.push(anyScope(branches
                    .filter((branch) => databaseFieldsAllowed({ [direction]: [field] }, resolveDatabaseFields([branch.config], action)))
                    .map((branch) => branch.scope)));
            }
        }
        return {
            scope: allScopes([...required, ...restrictions]),
            configured: branches.some((branch) => branch.configured),
        };
    }
    async compileConstraints(constraints, principal, resource, action) {
        const scopes = [];
        for (const constraint of constraints) {
            const selection = constraint.selection;
            if (selection.type === 'all') {
                scopes.push(true);
                continue;
            }
            if (selection.type === 'records') {
                scopes.push(idsScope(resource.primaryKey, selection.ids));
                continue;
            }
            scopes.push(...(await this.compileScopes(principal, resource, action, [
                selection.params === undefined
                    ? selection.key
                    : { key: selection.key, params: selection.params },
            ])));
        }
        return scopes;
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/dist/server/database/scope.js:1–56E3

condition/anyScope/allScopes/idsScope 实现：idsScope 对每个 id 生成一个 $eq，注释说明 FilterOperator 无 $in；allScopes 为 AND 折叠。

/**
 * Conditions are built literally rather than through `FilterBuilder`, which
 * picks `string()` or `number()` from a field's type. The Collection registry
 * records field names only.
 */
export function condition(field, operator, value) {
    return {
        kind: 'condition',
        path: [field],
        operator,
        ...(value === undefined ? {} : { value }),
    };
}
/**
 * A scope that matches no row, for a permitted action whose scope resolved to
 * `false`. A value cannot be both empty and not empty, in any dialect.
 */
export function noRowsScope(primaryKey) {
    return group('and', [
        condition(primaryKey, '$empty'),
        condition(primaryKey, '$notEmpty'),
    ]);
}
export function anyScope(scopes) {
    if (scopes.includes(true))
        return true;
    const items = scopes.filter((scope) => scope !== false);
    if (items.length === 0)
        return false;
    return items.length === 1 ? items[0] : group('or', items);
}
export function allScopes(scopes) {
    if (scopes.includes(false))
        return false;
    const items = scopes.filter((scope) => scope !== true);
    if (items.length === 0)
        return true;
    return items.length === 1 ? items[0] : group('and', items);
}
/**
 * Membership expands to one `$eq` per identifier because `FilterOperator` has
 * no `$in` — `$includes` is a substring test. A negated list would expand the
 * same way, as an `and` of `$ne`. Both collapse once db grows the operator.
 */
export function idsScope(field, ids) {
    return anyScope(ids.map((id) => condition(field, '$eq', id)));
}
/** Attach a scope to its Collection. `true` and `false` are decided by the caller. */
export function scopeAst(collection, scope) {
    return {
        kind: 'filter',
        version: 1,
        collection,
        root: scope.kind === 'group' ? scope : group('and', [scope]),
    };
}
packages/@nocobase/db/dist/src/repository/repository.js:1106–1160E7

validateResolvedConditionValue 对 integer/increments 字段只接受 Number.isSafeInteger 的数字，字符串值触发 INVALID_FILTER；即字符串 id 无法通过整数主键过滤。

function validateResolvedConditionValue(field, operator, value, path) {
    if (['$empty', '$notEmpty', '$isTruly', '$isFalsy'].includes(operator)) {
        return;
    }
    if (operator === '$dateBetween') {
        if (!Array.isArray(value) ||
            value.length !== 2 ||
            value.some((item) => !validDateLiteral(field.type, item))) {
            invalid('INVALID_FILTER', '$dateBetween requires two valid ISO values.', {
                field: field.name,
                path: [...path, 'value'],
            });
        }
        return;
    }
    const valid = (() => {
        switch (field.type) {
            case 'string':
            case 'char':
            case 'enum':
            case 'uuid':
            case 'text':
            case 'time':
                return (typeof value === 'string' ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'bigInt':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value)) ||
                    (typeof value === 'string' && /^[+-]?\d+$/.test(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'decimal':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) ||
                    (typeof value === 'string' &&
                        /^[+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?$/.test(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'increments':
            case 'integer':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'float':
            case 'double':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'date':
            case 'datetime':
            case 'datetimeTz':
                return ((value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)) ||
                    validDateLiteral(field.type, value));
            default:
                return false;
        }
    })();
    if (!valid) {
        invalid('INVALID_FILTER', `Filter value is invalid for Field "${field.name}" of type "${field.type}".`, { field: field.name, path: [...path, 'value'] });
    }
}

应用注释记录 records selection 只携带字符串 id 且本表为整数主键，会被过滤器校验拒绝；并复制了 allScopes，注释说明该 helper 不在包公开面。

  /**
   * The one record a temporary share points at.
   *
   * The authorization package's `records` selection carries string ids only,
   * and this table's primary key is an integer, so a `records` selection would
   * be rejected by the repository's filter validation. Naming the id in a
   * record access lets the resolver hand back a real number instead.
   */
  sharedDocument: 'library.sharedDocument',
} as const;

/** The params the `sharedDocument` record access reads. */
export interface SharedDocumentParams {
  readonly documentId?: unknown;
}

/**
 * The AND fold of the authorization package's internal `allScopes`.
 *
 * That helper is not part of the package's public surface, so the fold is
 * repeated here rather than reaching through a private subpath. `true` drops
 * out, `false` wins, and a single node collapses to itself.
 */
export function allScopes(scopes: readonly DatabaseScope[]): DatabaseScope {
  if (scopes.includes(false)) return false;
  const items = scopes.filter(
    (scope): scope is FilterNode => scope !== true && scope !== false,
  );
  if (items.length === 0) return true;
  return items.length === 1 ? items[0] : group('and', items);
}

/** Which records of a collection an action reaches. */
export type RecordSelection = {
    readonly type: 'all';
} | {
    readonly type: 'records';
    readonly ids: readonly string[];
} | {
    readonly type: 'recordAccess';
    readonly key: string;
    readonly params?: unknown;
};
export interface RecordSelectionHelpers {
    all(): RecordSelection;
    records(ids: readonly string[]): RecordSelection;
    recordAccess(key: string, params?: unknown): RecordSelection;
}

/** Validates an untrusted value, returning it as a detached selection. */

### [轻微][能力缺口] selection.records 只接受非空字符串 id，整数自增主键无法按记录授权

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/authorization`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.10）、`@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization`（评审时 0.2.0-beta.21）、`@nocobase/db`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.16）

parseRecordSelection 要求 records 的每个 id 都是非空字符串；authorizer.compileConstraints 把 records 直接交给 idsScope，而 idsScope 对每个 id 生成 condition(primaryKey,'$eq',id)。当 collection 主键为整数（本应用 documents.id 为 increments）时：传数字会在写入前抛 TypeError('Invalid record selection')；把数字转成字符串虽能通过选择校验，却会在查询时被 Repository 的过滤器类型校验以 INVALID_FILTER（integer 字段不接受 string 值，HTTP 500）拒绝。authorization 的 db 子包又明确注释 FilterOperator 无 $in。因此框架的 records 记录选择与其自身的整数自增主键能力无法组合。

**影响**：按记录共享/限制的最直观路径对整数主键 collection 不可用；照 Skill 指引使用会得到 500 而非授权，Agent 需读源码后自造 record access 才能完成单条授权，增加排查与实现成本。

**建议改动**：让 parseRecordSelection/selection.records 接受数字 id，或在编译 selection 时按目标主键字段类型归一化值；为无法表达的 selection 提供写入期校验与明确诊断（而不是查询期 500）；并为 FilterOperator 增加 $in。

**验收标准**：对 increments 与 uuid 两类主键，selection.records 均能创建规则且只命中目标记录，且无需应用自造 record access

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/authorization/dist/core/selection.js:1–24` — selection 构造器与 parseRecordSelection；records 分支要求每个 id typeof 'string' && id !== ''，否则抛 TypeError('Invalid record selection')，即整数 id 无法表达。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/dist/server/database/authorizer.js:206–267` — resolveEffectiveScope 以 anyScope 合并正向分支、allScopes 与限制取交集；compileConstraints 将 records selection 直接交给 idsScope(primaryKey, selection.ids)。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/dist/server/database/scope.js:1–56` — condition/anyScope/allScopes/idsScope 实现：idsScope 对每个 id 生成一个 $eq，注释说明 FilterOperator 无 $in；allScopes 为 AND 折叠。
- `packages/@nocobase/db/dist/src/repository/repository.js:1106–1160` — validateResolvedConditionValue 对 integer/increments 字段只接受 Number.isSafeInteger 的数字，字符串值触发 INVALID_FILTER；即字符串 id 无法通过整数主键过滤。
- `app/server/library/scope.ts:30–60` — 应用注释记录 records selection 只携带字符串 id 且本表为整数主键，会被过滤器校验拒绝；并复制了 allScopes，注释说明该 helper 不在包公开面。
- `app/database/main/migrations/202609200001_create_documents.ts:10–24` — documents 迁移以 collection.increments('id') 定义整数自增主键，ownerId 为 string 列承载 recordsIOwn。
- `packages/@nocobase/authorization/dist/core/selection.d.ts:1–19` — 公开类型 RecordSelection 的 records 分支为 ids: readonly string[]，RecordSelectionHelpers.records(ids: readonly string[])；类型层限定字符串 id，但不会提示整数主键 collection 在运行时失败。

工作流第 16 行："Use explicit records for one handover；use a record access selection for a maintained region or team rule"，把 records 推荐为单条交接做法。

## Development workflow

1. Identify the real collaboration exception: who receives which records, for which actions, and why. Use explicit records for one handover; use a record access selection for a maintained region or team rule.
2. Grant the recipients the business action through a permission set first. Register inherited subjects and their active membership resolver through the main authorization Skill.
3. Inspect every data scope the operation requires. Quote submission needs the selected quote and its actual parent project. Add each action and data scope deliberately; view, edit and submit are different permissions.
4. Save a complete rule through the settings page or the service. Keep record ids tied to their data scope's collection and preserve the other entries on update.
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules/SKILL.md:65–76E14

服务示例使用 selection.records(['quote-7']) 与 selection.records(['project-3'])；第 75 行说明 selection 可为 records(ids) 或 recordAccess(key,params?)，示例全为字符串主键。

    .title('Proposal handover')
    .subjects({ type: 'org.team', id: 'proposal' })
    .scope('edit', 'quotes', selection.records(['quote-7']))
    .scope('submit', 'quotes', selection.records(['quote-7']))
    .scope('submit', 'projects', selection.records(['project-3']))
    .reason('Delegate this proposal to the team')
    .build(),
);
```

A rule is `{ key, resource, actions, title?, subjects, reason? }` and each action is `{ action, scopeKey?, selection }`, where `selection` is `selection.records(ids)` or `selection.recordAccess(key, params?)`; `all` is refused. `create`, `update(key, rule)`, `delete(key)`, `get(key)`, `list()` and `withTransaction(connection)` validate before writing. A rule on a composite names the data scope in `scopeKey` and affects only that composite action's branch; a rule on a `database.collection` omits `scopeKey` and applies across every branch that reaches the collection. Neither form shares related records implicitly or replaces field and relation capabilities, and unrestricted identities skip every rule.
packages/@nocobase/authorization/dist/core/selection.js:1–24E1

selection 构造器与 parseRecordSelection；records 分支要求每个 id typeof 'string' && id !== ''，否则抛 TypeError('Invalid record selection')，即整数 id 无法表达。

export const selection = {
    all: () => ({ type: 'all' }),
    records: (ids) => ({ type: 'records', ids: [...ids] }),
    recordAccess: (key, params) => params === undefined
        ? { type: 'recordAccess', key }
        : { type: 'recordAccess', key, params: structuredClone(params) },
};
/** Validates an untrusted value, returning it as a detached selection. */
export function parseRecordSelection(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)) {
        const type = Reflect.get(value, 'type');
        if (type === 'all')
            return selection.all();
        const ids = Reflect.get(value, 'ids');
        if (type === 'records' &&
            Array.isArray(ids) &&
            ids.every((id) => typeof id === 'string' && id !== ''))
            return selection.records(ids);
        const key = Reflect.get(value, 'key');
        if (type === 'recordAccess' && typeof key === 'string' && key)
            return selection.recordAccess(key, Reflect.get(value, 'params'));
    }
    throw new TypeError('Invalid record selection');
}

validateResolvedConditionValue 对 integer/increments 字段只接受 Number.isSafeInteger 的数字，字符串值触发 INVALID_FILTER；即字符串 id 无法通过整数主键过滤。

function validateResolvedConditionValue(field, operator, value, path) {
    if (['$empty', '$notEmpty', '$isTruly', '$isFalsy'].includes(operator)) {
        return;
    }
    if (operator === '$dateBetween') {
        if (!Array.isArray(value) ||
            value.length !== 2 ||
            value.some((item) => !validDateLiteral(field.type, item))) {
            invalid('INVALID_FILTER', '$dateBetween requires two valid ISO values.', {
                field: field.name,
                path: [...path, 'value'],
            });
        }
        return;
    }
    const valid = (() => {
        switch (field.type) {
            case 'string':
            case 'char':
            case 'enum':
            case 'uuid':
            case 'text':
            case 'time':
                return (typeof value === 'string' ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'bigInt':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value)) ||
                    (typeof value === 'string' && /^[+-]?\d+$/.test(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'decimal':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) ||
                    (typeof value === 'string' &&
                        /^[+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?$/.test(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'increments':
            case 'integer':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'float':
            case 'double':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'date':
            case 'datetime':
            case 'datetimeTz':
                return ((value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)) ||
                    validDateLiteral(field.type, value));
            default:
                return false;
        }
    })();
    if (!valid) {
        invalid('INVALID_FILTER', `Filter value is invalid for Field "${field.name}" of type "${field.type}".`, { field: field.name, path: [...path, 'value'] });
    }
}

/** Which records of a collection an action reaches. */
export type RecordSelection = {
    readonly type: 'all';
} | {
    readonly type: 'records';
    readonly ids: readonly string[];
} | {
    readonly type: 'recordAccess';
    readonly key: string;
    readonly params?: unknown;
};
export interface RecordSelectionHelpers {
    all(): RecordSelection;
    records(ids: readonly string[]): RecordSelection;
    recordAccess(key: string, params?: unknown): RecordSelection;
}

/** Validates an untrusted value, returning it as a detached selection. */

condition/anyScope/allScopes/idsScope 实现：idsScope 对每个 id 生成一个 $eq，注释说明 FilterOperator 无 $in；allScopes 为 AND 折叠。

/**
 * Conditions are built literally rather than through `FilterBuilder`, which
 * picks `string()` or `number()` from a field's type. The Collection registry
 * records field names only.
 */
export function condition(field, operator, value) {
    return {
        kind: 'condition',
        path: [field],
        operator,
        ...(value === undefined ? {} : { value }),
    };
}
/**
 * A scope that matches no row, for a permitted action whose scope resolved to
 * `false`. A value cannot be both empty and not empty, in any dialect.
 */
export function noRowsScope(primaryKey) {
    return group('and', [
        condition(primaryKey, '$empty'),
        condition(primaryKey, '$notEmpty'),
    ]);
}
export function anyScope(scopes) {
    if (scopes.includes(true))
        return true;
    const items = scopes.filter((scope) => scope !== false);
    if (items.length === 0)
        return false;
    return items.length === 1 ? items[0] : group('or', items);
}
export function allScopes(scopes) {
    if (scopes.includes(false))
        return false;
    const items = scopes.filter((scope) => scope !== true);
    if (items.length === 0)
        return true;
    return items.length === 1 ? items[0] : group('and', items);
}
/**
 * Membership expands to one `$eq` per identifier because `FilterOperator` has
 * no `$in` — `$includes` is a substring test. A negated list would expand the
 * same way, as an `and` of `$ne`. Both collapse once db grows the operator.
 */
export function idsScope(field, ids) {
    return anyScope(ids.map((id) => condition(field, '$eq', id)));
}
/** Attach a scope to its Collection. `true` and `false` are decided by the caller. */
export function scopeAst(collection, scope) {
    return {
        kind: 'filter',
        version: 1,
        collection,
        root: scope.kind === 'group' ? scope : group('and', [scope]),
    };
}

应用注释记录 records selection 只携带字符串 id 且本表为整数主键，会被过滤器校验拒绝；并复制了 allScopes，注释说明该 helper 不在包公开面。

  /**
   * The one record a temporary share points at.
   *
   * The authorization package's `records` selection carries string ids only,
   * and this table's primary key is an integer, so a `records` selection would
   * be rejected by the repository's filter validation. Naming the id in a
   * record access lets the resolver hand back a real number instead.
   */
  sharedDocument: 'library.sharedDocument',
} as const;

/** The params the `sharedDocument` record access reads. */
export interface SharedDocumentParams {
  readonly documentId?: unknown;
}

/**
 * The AND fold of the authorization package's internal `allScopes`.
 *
 * That helper is not part of the package's public surface, so the fold is
 * repeated here rather than reaching through a private subpath. `true` drops
 * out, `false` wins, and a single node collapses to itself.
 */
export function allScopes(scopes: readonly DatabaseScope[]): DatabaseScope {
  if (scopes.includes(false)) return false;
  const items = scopes.filter(
    (scope): scope is FilterNode => scope !== true && scope !== false,
  );
  if (items.length === 0) return true;
  return items.length === 1 ? items[0] : group('and', items);
}

本轮过程记录

在 NocoBase 3 app-template-default 上实现了内部资料阅读与临时共享：新建 documents 集合；资料编辑/资料阅读两个权限集并分配给甲、乙；对乙的保密限制规则；管理员复用内置 sharing-rules 做临时单条共享与撤销；资料页与集成自测。服务器/客户端/node 三套类型检查通过，相关逻辑测试全部通过。修复了工厂 lint 阶段报告的 12 个错误（react-hooks/set-state-in-effect、@typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-type-assertion、@typescript-eslint/no-base-to-string、@typescript-eslint/no-misused-promises），仅重跑相关文件的 lint/format/typecheck 与两个相关测试后通过。

问题 01 · 实现阶段

整数主键集合无法使用内置 sharing-rules 的 records 记录选择

本任务已处理

管理员临时共享某份草稿给阅读者后，阅读者 GET /api/library/documents/:id 返回 HTTP 500：RepositoryError: Filter value is invalid for Field "id" of type "integer"。

原因（实现者自述）
@nocobase/authorization 的 RecordSelection.records 只接受 string[]（selection.records 与 parseRecordSelection 都要求非空字符串 id）；authorizer.compileConstraints 用 idsScope(primaryKey, ids) 直接生成 id $eq '<字符串>' 条件，而 @nocobase/db 的过滤值校验对 increments/integer 字段只接受 number，于是共享规则一旦命中整数主键就抛 INVALID_FILTER。
处理方式
不更换主键类型：定义自定义 Record Access library.sharedDocument，params.documentId 为数字，sharing rule 用 recordAccess 选择携带数字 id，resolver 返回 condition('id','$eq',number)，绕开 records 的字符串限制，同时仍留在内置 sharing-rules 机制内。修复后 9 条集成测试全部通过。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

工厂 lint 输出：client/pages/library/document-form-dialog.tsx、index.tsx、share-panel.tsx 的 react-hooks/set-state-in-effect（同步 setState）；errors.ts 与 server 的 no-unnecessary-type-assertion；server/library/service.ts 的 no-base-to-string；document-form-dialog.tsx 的 no-misused-promises。

原因（实现者自述）
1) React Compiler 的 set-state-in-effect 规则不认识 async/await，把 async 回调（reload）里 await 之后的 setState 当作 effect 内同步调用，也把“用 effect 把 props 同步进 state 的表单初始化”和“用 effect 写默认选项”判为反模式；2) 若干处对已经由 `in` 收窄或 token 泛型确定的值做了多余断言；3) 把 unknown/可能为对象的值直接 String()；4) 把返回 Promise 的函数直接交给 onSubmit。
处理方式
表单初始化改用 useState 初值 + 由父页递增的 key 在打开时重挂载，删除同步 effect；share-panel 的默认文档选择改为派生值；数据加载 effect 里的 reload 改写为返回 fetch(...).then(成功/失败回调)，让 setState 只发生在异步回调；errors.ts 与两处 route/service 断言改为 in 收窄后取值，server 去掉多余 AppAuthorization 断言；toStringOrNull 只对 string/number/boolean/Date 处理，其余返回 null 并复用于 content/username；onSubmit 包成 `(event) => void submit(event)`。改后 `eslint . --ignore-pattern '.github/**'` 零错误，相关文件 format/typecheck 与 client-routes、library-authorization 测试均通过。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · framework

@nocobase/authorization 的 records 记录选择应支持非字符串主键

可自动化

selection.records(ids: string[]) 与 idsScope 生成的 $eq 值不会按目标字段类型归一化，任何 integer/bigInt 主键集合使用内置 records 选择都会触发 INVALID_FILTER，调用方只能改主键类型或改用 recordAccess + params 绕过。

建议改动

在 authorizer/idsScope 中依据 resource 的字段类型把字符串 id 转换为对应标量（或允许 records 接受 number[]），让内置 sharing-rules 的单条记录选择适用于整数主键集合。

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · lint

react-hooks/set-state-in-effect 对 async/await 的判定过于宽泛

可自动化

该规则（React Compiler recommended preset）把 `useEffect(() => { void reload(); }, [reload])` 中 reload 内 await 之后的 setState 也判为 effect 内同步 setState，逼使数据加载改用 fetch(...).then(回调) 的写法才通过；而模板自身的 client/routing/client-route.tsx 正是采用 .then 回调。

建议改动

要么在规则实现中区分 await 之后（微任务）的 setState，要么在应用 ESLint 配置中为纯数据加载场景提供受认可的 hook（如 useAsyncEffect）并示例，避免每个开发者各自发明绕过写法。

来源：Agent · retro.json

以内部资料阅读与临时共享场景为测试用例，独立审查 NocoBase3 授权内核与应用集成、sharing-rules、restriction-rules、default-access、authentication/users 五个能力单元。框架的授权组合模型在本场景成立：权限集 data scope 决定身份可见集合（B01），sharing rule（effect=expand）完成单条记录临时开放与撤销（B02/B03），restriction rule（effect=restrict）与所有正向范围取交集，使保密资料在共享后仍不可见（B04），停用账号即失效既有会话由认证插件与 Users 管理内置完成（B05），应用无需为停用写代码。主要框架问题：selection.records 只接受非空字符串 id，应用 documents.id 为整数自增主键，按记录授权不可用——数字在写入时抛 TypeError，字符串在查询时被 Repository 过滤器类型校验以 INVALID_FILTER（HTTP 500）拒绝；文档把 records 推荐为单条交接做法却只给字符串主键示例，属能力缺口叠加指引缺口。应用以自定义 recordAccess(library.sharedDocument) 返回数字 $eq 绕行。次要问题：app-plugin-authorization/server 未导出 allScopes/idsScope 等组合子，应用被迫复制 allScopes。所有 28 条历史错误信号经原文核对均为探路/工具类报错，非框架缺陷；UI 因当前评审模型无法渲染 PNG，未做视觉结论。

⌄

grant（权限集 data scope）负责正向范围，constraint 分 expand（sharing/default-access）与 restrict（限制规则）；authorizer 以 anyScope 合并正向分支、以 allScopes 与限制取交集，B01–B04 均可由框架公开能力组合完成，无需应用自造裁决引擎。

提供的帮助

应保留的能力

证据与原文

E1 · packages/@nocobase/authorization/dist/core/selection.js:1–24

export const selection = {
    all: () => ({ type: 'all' }),
    records: (ids) => ({ type: 'records', ids: [...ids] }),
    recordAccess: (key, params) => params === undefined
        ? { type: 'recordAccess', key }
        : { type: 'recordAccess', key, params: structuredClone(params) },
};
/** Validates an untrusted value, returning it as a detached selection. */
export function parseRecordSelection(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)) {
        const type = Reflect.get(value, 'type');
        if (type === 'all')
            return selection.all();
        const ids = Reflect.get(value, 'ids');
        if (type === 'records' &&
            Array.isArray(ids) &&
            ids.every((id) => typeof id === 'string' && id !== ''))
            return selection.records(ids);
        const key = Reflect.get(value, 'key');
        if (type === 'recordAccess' && typeof key === 'string' && key)
            return selection.recordAccess(key, Reflect.get(value, 'params'));
    }
    throw new TypeError('Invalid record selection');
}

/**
 * Conditions are built literally rather than through `FilterBuilder`, which
 * picks `string()` or `number()` from a field's type. The Collection registry
 * records field names only.
 */
export function condition(field, operator, value) {
    return {
        kind: 'condition',
        path: [field],
        operator,
        ...(value === undefined ? {} : { value }),
    };
}
/**
 * A scope that matches no row, for a permitted action whose scope resolved to
 * `false`. A value cannot be both empty and not empty, in any dialect.
 */
export function noRowsScope(primaryKey) {
    return group('and', [
        condition(primaryKey, '$empty'),
        condition(primaryKey, '$notEmpty'),
    ]);
}
export function anyScope(scopes) {
    if (scopes.includes(true))
        return true;
    const items = scopes.filter((scope) => scope !== false);
    if (items.length === 0)
        return false;
    return items.length === 1 ? items[0] : group('or', items);
}
export function allScopes(scopes) {
    if (scopes.includes(false))
        return false;
    const items = scopes.filter((scope) => scope !== true);
    if (items.length === 0)
        return true;
    return items.length === 1 ? items[0] : group('and', items);
}
/**
 * Membership expands to one `$eq` per identifier because `FilterOperator` has
 * no `$in` — `$includes` is a substring test. A negated list would expand the
 * same way, as an `and` of `$ne`. Both collapse once db grows the operator.
 */
export function idsScope(field, ids) {
    return anyScope(ids.map((id) => condition(field, '$eq', id)));
}
/** Attach a scope to its Collection. `true` and `false` are decided by the caller. */
export function scopeAst(collection, scope) {
    return {
        kind: 'filter',
        version: 1,
        collection,
        root: scope.kind === 'group' ? scope : group('and', [scope]),
    };
}

    async resolveEffectiveScope(principal, resource, action, configs, constraints, requestedFields) {
        // Each grant keeps its own fields and role filters through scope evaluation.
        const branches = await Promise.all(configs.map(async (config) => {
            const positive = await this.compileScopes(principal, resource, action, config.recordAccess ?? []);
            positive.push(...(await this.compileConstraints([...constraints, ...(config.branchConstraints ?? [])].filter((item) => item.effect === 'expand'), principal, resource, action)));
            const branchRestrictions = await this.compileConstraints((config.branchConstraints ?? []).filter((item) => item.effect === 'restrict'), principal, resource, action);
            return {
                config,
                configured: positive.length > 0,
                scope: allScopes([anyScope(positive), ...branchRestrictions]),
            };
        }));
        const restrictions = await this.compileConstraints(constraints.filter((item) => item.effect === 'restrict'), principal, resource, action);
        const fields = resolveDatabaseFields(configs, action);
        const requested = {
            ...requestedFields,
            ...(action === 'read'
                ? { output: resolveActionFields(action, fields, resource) }
                : { input: resolveActionFields(action, fields, resource) }),
        };
        const required = [
            anyScope(branches.map((branch) => branch.scope)),
        ];
        for (const direction of [
            'input',
            'output',
            'filter',
            'sort',
            'group',
        ]) {
            for (const field of requested[direction] ?? []) {
                if (branches.every((branch) => databaseFieldsAllowed({ [direction]: [field] }, resolveDatabaseFields([branch.config], action))))
                    continue;
                required.push(anyScope(branches
                    .filter((branch) => databaseFieldsAllowed({ [direction]: [field] }, resolveDatabaseFields([branch.config], action)))
                    .map((branch) => branch.scope)));
            }
        }
        return {
            scope: allScopes([...required, ...restrictions]),
            configured: branches.some((branch) => branch.configured),
        };
    }
    async compileConstraints(constraints, principal, resource, action) {
        const scopes = [];
        for (const constraint of constraints) {
            const selection = constraint.selection;
            if (selection.type === 'all') {
                scopes.push(true);
                continue;
            }
            if (selection.type === 'records') {
                scopes.push(idsScope(resource.primaryKey, selection.ids));
                continue;
            }
            scopes.push(...(await this.compileScopes(principal, resource, action, [
                selection.params === undefined
                    ? selection.key
                    : { key: selection.key, params: selection.params },
            ])));
        }
        return scopes;

validateResolvedConditionValue 对 integer/increments 字段只接受 Number.isSafeInteger 的数字，字符串值触发 INVALID_FILTER；即字符串 id 无法通过整数主键过滤。

function validateResolvedConditionValue(field, operator, value, path) {
    if (['$empty', '$notEmpty', '$isTruly', '$isFalsy'].includes(operator)) {
        return;
    }
    if (operator === '$dateBetween') {
        if (!Array.isArray(value) ||
            value.length !== 2 ||
            value.some((item) => !validDateLiteral(field.type, item))) {
            invalid('INVALID_FILTER', '$dateBetween requires two valid ISO values.', {
                field: field.name,
                path: [...path, 'value'],
            });
        }
        return;
    }
    const valid = (() => {
        switch (field.type) {
            case 'string':
            case 'char':
            case 'enum':
            case 'uuid':
            case 'text':
            case 'time':
                return (typeof value === 'string' ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'bigInt':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value)) ||
                    (typeof value === 'string' && /^[+-]?\d+$/.test(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'decimal':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) ||
                    (typeof value === 'string' &&
                        /^[+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?$/.test(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'increments':
            case 'integer':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'float':
            case 'double':
                return ((typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) ||
                    (value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)));
            case 'date':
            case 'datetime':
            case 'datetimeTz':
                return ((value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)) ||
                    validDateLiteral(field.type, value));
            default:
                return false;
        }
    })();
    if (!valid) {
        invalid('INVALID_FILTER', `Filter value is invalid for Field "${field.name}" of type "${field.type}".`, { field: field.name, path: [...path, 'value'] });
    }
}

/** Rejects a malformed rule before it reaches a store. */
export function validateRule(rule, kind) {
    if (!rule.key)
        throw new TypeError('A rule needs a key');
    if (!rule.resource.type || !rule.resource.id)
        throw new TypeError(`Rule ${rule.key} needs a resource`);
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const action of rule.actions) {
        if (!action.action)
            throw new TypeError(`Rule ${rule.key} has an unnamed action`);
        const id = JSON.stringify([action.action, action.scopeKey ?? null]);
        if (seen.has(id))
            throw new TypeError(`Rule ${rule.key} repeats ${action.action}`);
        seen.add(id);
        const selection = parseRecordSelection(action.selection);
        if (selection.type === 'all' && !kind.allowAll)
            throw new TypeError(`A ${kind.id} rule cannot select all records`);
    }
}
export class RuleService {
    kind;
    store;
    id;
    constructor(kind, store) {
        this.kind = kind;
        this.store = store;
        this.id = kind.id;
    }
    withTransaction(transaction) {
        return new RuleService(this.kind, this.store.withTransaction(transaction));
    }
    async create(rule) {
        validateRule(rule, this.kind);
        await this.assertResourceFree(rule, undefined);
        return this.store.create(rule);
    }
    async update(key, rule) {
        validateRule(rule, this.kind);
        await this.assertResourceFree(rule, key);
        return this.store.update(key, rule);
    }
    async assertResourceFree(rule, replacing) {
        const conflict = this.kind.onePerResource;
        if (!conflict)
            return;
        const existing = (await this.store.list()).find((entry) => entry.key !== replacing &&
            entry.resource.type === rule.resource.type &&
            entry.resource.id === rule.resource.id);
        if (existing)
            throw conflict(rule, existing);
    }
    delete(key) {
        return this.store.delete(key);
    }
    get(key) {
        return this.store.get(key);
    }
    list() {
        return this.store.list();
    }
    /** Reads the rules once per identity context. */
    for() {
        let rules;
        return {
            id: this.id,
            resolve: async (input) => this.constraints(input, await (rules ??= this.store.list())),
        };
    }
    async resolve(input) {
        return this.constraints(input, await this.store.list());
    }

export function createSharingRulesHandler(authz, api) {
    const routes = createSettingsRouter();
    const checked = (value) => {
        const rule = parse.rule(value, { withSubjects: true });
        validateDataScopeRule(authz, rule);
        return { ...rule, subjects: rule.subjects ?? [] };
    };
    routes.route('/', createRuleSupportRoutes(authz, SHARING_RULES_RULE));
    routes.get(PATH, async (context) => {
        await requireSettings(context.env.authorization, SHARING_RULES_SETTINGS, 'read');
        return context.json({ data: await api.list() });
    });
    routes.post(PATH, async (context) => {
        await requireSettings(context.env.authorization, SHARING_RULES_SETTINGS, 'create');
        return context.json({ data: await api.create(checked(await context.req.json())) }, 201);
    });
    routes.put(`${PATH}/:key`, async (context) => {
        await requireSettings(context.env.authorization, SHARING_RULES_SETTINGS, 'update');
        const key = context.req.param('key');
        if (!(await api.get(key)))
            return context.json({ code: 'RULE_NOT_FOUND' }, 404);
        return context.json({
            data: await api.update(key, checked(await context.req.json())),
        });
    });
    routes.delete(`${PATH}/:key`, async (context) => {
        await requireSettings(context.env.authorization, SHARING_RULES_SETTINGS, 'delete');
        await api.delete(context.req.param('key'));
        return context.body(null, 204);
    });
    return createRouteHandler(routes);

    async create(rule) {
        const id = crypto.randomUUID();
        const now = new Date();
        await this.connection().transaction(async (connection) => {
            await connection.query
                .insertInto(RULES)
                .values(this.toValues(rule, id, now, now))
                .execute();
            await this.replaceAssignments(connection, id, rule.subjects);
        });
        return rule;

    async update(key, rule) {
        await this.connection().transaction(async (connection) => {
            const current = await connection.query
                .selectFrom(RULES)
                .select('id')
                .where('key', '=', key)
                .executeTakeFirst();
            if (!current)
                throw new Error(`Unknown Sharing Rule: ${key}`);
            const id = String(current.id);
            await connection.query
                .updateTable(RULES)
                .set(this.toUpdateValues(rule))
                .where('id', '=', id)
                .execute();
            await connection.query
                .deleteFrom(ASSIGNMENTS)
                .where('sharingRuleId', '=', id)
                .execute();
            await this.replaceAssignments(connection, id, rule.subjects);
        });
        return rule;
    }
    async delete(key) {
        await this.connection().transaction(async (connection) => {
            const current = await connection.query
                .selectFrom(RULES)
                .select('id')
                .where('key', '=', key)
                .executeTakeFirst();
            if (!current)
                return;
            const id = String(current.id);

                .deleteFrom(ASSIGNMENTS)
                .where('sharingRuleId', '=', id)
                .execute();
            await connection.query.deleteFrom(RULES).where('id', '=', id).execute();
        });
    }

export function sharingRules(options = {}) {
    const connection = new DatabaseConnectionHandle('Sharing Rules');
    const plugin = sharingRulesPlugin({
        store: options.store ?? new DatabaseSharingRuleStore(connection.resolve),
    });
    return {
        ...plugin,
        dependencies: ['settings', 'database', 'ui'],
        setup(authz) {
            connection.set(authz.connection);
            plugin.setup?.(authz);
            authz.settings.add({
                id: SHARING_RULES_SETTINGS,
                title: { key: 'resourceTitle', ns: NAMESPACE },
                actions: ['read', 'create', 'update', 'delete'].map((name) => ({
                    name,
                    title: { key: `options.actions.${name}`, ns: APP_NAMESPACE },
                })),
            });
            authz.ui.place({ type: 'settings', id: SHARING_RULES_SETTINGS }, { section: AUTHORIZATION_SETTINGS_SECTION, order: 20 });
            authz.routes.add(`/${SHARING_RULES_RULE}`, createSharingRulesHandler(authz, plugin.authorizationApi.sharingRules));
        },
    };
}

export function sharingRulesPlugin(options) {

    return {
        id: 'sharing-rules',

        setup(authz) {
            authz.constraints.add(service);

    };
}

## Development workflow

1. Identify the real collaboration exception: who receives which records, for which actions, and why. Use explicit records for one handover; use a record access selection for a maintained region or team rule.
2. Grant the recipients the business action through a permission set first. Register inherited subjects and their active membership resolver through the main authorization Skill.
3. Inspect every data scope the operation requires. Quote submission needs the selected quote and its actual parent project. Add each action and data scope deliberately; view, edit and submit are different permissions.
4. Save a complete rule through the settings page or the service. Keep record ids tied to their data scope's collection and preserve the other entries on update.
```

A rule is `{ key, resource, actions, title?, subjects, reason? }` and each action is `{ action, scopeKey?, selection }`, where `selection` is `selection.records(ids)` or `selection.recordAccess(key, params?)`; `all` is refused. `create`, `update(key, rule)`, `delete(key)`, `get(key)`, `list()` and `withTransaction(connection)` validate before writing. A rule on a composite names the data scope in `scopeKey` and affects only that composite action's branch; a rule on a `database.collection` omits `scopeKey` and applies across every branch that reaches the collection. Neither form shares related records implicitly or replaces field and relation capabilities, and unrestricted identities skip every rule.

export function restrictionRulesPlugin(options) {
    const service = new RuleService({
        id: 'restriction-rules',
        effect: 'restrict',
        bySubject: true,
        allowAll: true,
    }, requireStore(options.store, 'Restriction Rules'));
    return {
        id: 'restriction-rules',
        authorizationApi: {
            restrictionRules: service,
        },
        setup(authz) {
            authz.constraints.add(service);
        },
    };
}

# Develop default access

Default access adds a shared record baseline for every identity that already holds an action. It does not grant the action, page access or additional fields. A baseline combines with permission-set data scopes and sharing, and restriction rules still narrow the result, so choose it as an intentional minimum range rather than a fallback for identities without a scope of their own.

Read the installed `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill first for composite resources, data scopes, fields, server policy enforcement and inherited subjects. The package README at `node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-default-access/README.md` is the complete reference for the service, the HTTP routes and the exports; this Skill covers how to use them.

For a department-scoped baseline, read the application development Skill's `references/organization/permission-design.md` first. Its core works with permission sets alone, and its optional default-access section explains why a global default suits a department scope only when everyone holding the action belongs to a department.

## Development workflow

1. Identify which records every holder of a particular operation should receive by default. A read baseline can be broad while edit remains preparer-only; do not copy read defaults into write operations.
2. Confirm the composite, action and data scope exist and that the scope's grants target the intended collection. Reuse an applicable record access or define one through the main authorization Skill.
3. Save one rule per resource under a stable `key`; a second rule on the same resource is rejected, so extend the existing rule instead. A rule lists every action and data scope it widens; updating it replaces the whole rule, and deleting it removes the baseline, not the permission-set action.
4. Verify a holder receives the baseline, a person without the action remains denied, and restrictions still remove excluded rows. Also verify an explicit narrow data scope is not unexpectedly broadened by a permissive default.

For example, a quote view baseline can follow related-project ownership while editing follows the preparer, and a job's permission set can separately grant broad viewing that confidentiality restrictions narrow. A project's owner is not necessarily the author of every quote on that project.

| Method                                              | Effect                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `list({ page, pageSize, search, status, userIds })` | Paged users; `pageSize` caps at 100; `status` is `'enabled'` or `'disabled'`                           |
| `get(userId)`                                       | One user or `undefined`                                                                                |
| `create({ name, email, username?, password })`      | Creates the user and a credential account; email and username are normalized to lower case             |
| `update(userId, { name?, email?, username? })`      | `username: null` clears it                                                                             |
| `disable(userId)`                                   | Sets `disabledAt`, deletes every session, disconnects realtime; sign-in returns `403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED` |
| `enable(userId)`                                    | Clears `disabledAt`; the user signs in again, old sessions stay gone                                   |
| `resetPassword(userId, password)`                   | Rehashes and revokes sessions                                                                          |
| `revokeSessions(userId)`                            | Deletes sessions and disconnects realtime without changing state                                       |
| `withConnection(connection)`                        | Binds every operation to a caller-owned transaction                                                    |

  /**
   * The one record a temporary share points at.
   *
   * The authorization package's `records` selection carries string ids only,
   * and this table's primary key is an integer, so a `records` selection would
   * be rejected by the repository's filter validation. Naming the id in a
   * record access lets the resolver hand back a real number instead.
   */
  sharedDocument: 'library.sharedDocument',
} as const;

/** The params the `sharedDocument` record access reads. */
export interface SharedDocumentParams {
  readonly documentId?: unknown;
}

/**
 * The AND fold of the authorization package's internal `allScopes`.
 *
 * That helper is not part of the package's public surface, so the fold is
 * repeated here rather than reaching through a private subpath. `true` drops
 * out, `false` wins, and a single node collapses to itself.
 */
export function allScopes(scopes: readonly DatabaseScope[]): DatabaseScope {
  if (scopes.includes(false)) return false;
  const items = scopes.filter(
    (scope): scope is FilterNode => scope !== true && scope !== false,
  );
  if (items.length === 0) return true;
  return items.length === 1 ? items[0] : group('and', items);
}

          ns: 'nb3-factory',
        },
        subjects: [{ type: 'user', id: recipientId }],
        reason: `临时开放资料 #${documentId} 给 ${recipientId}`,
      });
      created.push(this.toShare(rule, String(document.title)));
    }
    return created;
  }

  async deleteShare(actor: LibraryActor, key: string): Promise<void> {
    void actor;
    if (!key.startsWith(SHARE_KEY_PREFIX)) {
      throw new LibraryError(
        'SHARE_NOT_FOUND',
        'That sharing rule is not managed here',
        404,
      );
    }
    const existing = await this.sharingRules().get(key);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new LibraryError('SHARE_NOT_FOUND', 'Share not found', 404);
    }
    await this.sharingRules().delete(key);
  }

/** Which records of a collection an action reaches. */
export type RecordSelection = {
    readonly type: 'all';
} | {
    readonly type: 'records';
    readonly ids: readonly string[];
} | {
    readonly type: 'recordAccess';
    readonly key: string;
    readonly params?: unknown;
};
export interface RecordSelectionHelpers {
    all(): RecordSelection;
    records(ids: readonly string[]): RecordSelection;
    recordAccess(key: string, params?: unknown): RecordSelection;
}
export declare const selection: RecordSelectionHelpers;
/** Validates an untrusted value, returning it as a detached selection. */
export declare function parseRecordSelection(value: unknown): RecordSelection;

{"type":"message_start","message":{"role":"toolResult","toolCallId":"call_00_zu2IAZKZmMHE5JuLAlEV3100","toolName":"bash","content":[{"type":"text","text":"agent-browser snapshot -i\n\n# Pick the email/password refs out of the snapshot, then:\nagent-browser fill @e3 \"user@example.com\"\nagent-browser fill @e4 \"hunter2\"\nagent-browser click @e5\nagent-browser wait --url \"**/dashboard\"\nagent-browser snapshot -i\n```\n\nCredentials in shell history are a leak. For anything sensitive, use the auth vault (see [references/authentication.md](references/authentication.md)):\n\n```bash\nagent-browser auth save my-app --url https://app.example.com/login \\\n  --username user@example.com --password-stdin\n# (type password, Ctrl+D)\n\nagent-browser auth login my-app    # fills + clicks, waits for form\n```\n\nIf credentials live in an external vault, use a configured credential provider plugin instead of putting secrets in the command line:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser plugin add agent-browser-plugin-vault --name vault\nagent-browser plugin list\nagent-browser auth login my-app --credential-provider vault --item \"My App\"\nagent-browser auth login my-app --credential-provider vault --item \"My App\" --url https://app.example.com/login --username-selector \"#email\" --password-selector \"#password\"\n```\n\nPlugins can also provide browser providers, launch mutators such as stealth setup, and arbitrary namespaced commands:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser --provider cloud-browser open https://example.com\nagent-browser plugin run captcha captcha.solve --payload '{\"siteKey\":\"...\",\"url\":\"https://example.com\"}'\n```\n\n`plugin run` is for `command.run` and custom capabilities. Core capabilities and protocol request types use their dedicated command paths.\n\n### Persist session across runs\n\n```bash\n# Derive one stable id for this agent/worktree\nSESSION=\"$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix my-app)\"\n\n# Pass the same id and restore request on every command\nagent-browser --session \"$SESSION\" --restore open https://app.example.com\n```\n\n`--restore` with no value uses the current `--session` as the persistence key. Agent skills should prefer this over hand-built state file paths. Use `--restore-save auto` by default so a failed restore does not overwrite the previous known-good state. State is saved on close and also periodically while the browser is open (at most once per `AGENT_BROWSER_AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_MS`, default 30000), so state survives even if the user closes the browser window by hand.\n\n```bash\nagent-browser --session \"$SESSION\" --restore --restore-check-text Dashboard open https://app.example.com\nagent-browser --session \"$SESSION\" session info --json\n```\n\n### Extract data\n\n```bash\n# Structured snapshot (best for AI reasoning over page content)\nagent-browser snapshot -i --json > page.json\n\n# Targeted extraction with refs\nagent-browser snapshot -i\nagent-browser get text @e5\nagent-browser get attr @e10 href\n\n# Arbitrary shape via JavaScript\ncat <<'EOF' | agent-browser eval --stdin\nconst rows = document.querySelectorAll(\"table tbody tr\");\nArray.from(rows).map(r => ({\n  name: r.cells[0].innerText,\n  price: r.cells[1].innerText,\n}));\nEOF\n```\n\nPrefer `eval --stdin` (heredoc) or `eval -b <base64>` for any JS with quotes or special characters. Inline `agent-browser eval \"...\"` works only for simple expressions.\n\n### Screenshot\n\n```bash\nagent-browser screenshot                        # temp path, printed on stdout\nagent-browser screenshot page.png               # specific path\nagent-browser screenshot --full full.png        # full scroll height\nagent-browser screenshot --annotate map.png     # numbered labels + legend keyed to snapshot refs\n```\n\nHeadless Chromium screenshots hide native scrollbars for consistent image output. Pass `--hide-scrollbars false` when launching to keep native scrollbars visible.\n\n`--annotate` is designed for multimodal models: each label `[N]` maps to ref `@eN`.\n\n### Handle multiple pages via tabs\n\n```bash\nagent-browser tab                      # list open tabs (with stable tabId)\nagent-browser tab new https://docs...  # open a new tab (and switch to it)\nagent-browser tab t2                   # switch to tab t2\nagent-browser tab close t2             # close tab t2\n```\n\nStable `tabId`s mean `t2` points at the same tab across commands even when other tabs open or close. After switching, refs from a prior snapshot on a different tab no longer apply — re-snapshot. `tab list --json` also reports each tab's CDP `targetId`, accepted anywhere a tab ref is accepted; target ids stay stable across daemon restarts, unlike `t<N>` ids.\n\nSwitching has two special cases worth knowing:\n\n- **Discarded tab (Chrome Memory Saver).** A backgrounded tab may have its renderer dropped. Switching to it reactivates the tab, which reloads the page and discards unsaved state (form input, scroll position). The switch result then includes `\"revived\": true`, so treat prior in-page state as gone and re-snapshot. Closing the active tab onto a discarded successor reports `\"activeTabRevived\": true` for the same reason.\n- **Tab blocked by a dialog.** If the target tab has an open dialog (`confirm`/`prompt`, or `alert`/`beforeunload` under `--no-auto-dialog`) its renderer is paused, not discarded, so the switch leaves it untouched and reports `\"dialogBlocked\": true`. Resolve the dialog with `dialog accept`/`dialog dismiss` before interacting with the page.\n\n### Run multiple browsers in parallel\n\nEach `--session <name>` is an isolated browser with its own cookies, tabs, and refs. For agent skills, derive stable names with `agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix <skill>`. Useful for testing multi-user flows or parallel scraping:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser --session a open https://app.example.com\nagent-browser --session b open https://app.example.com\nagent-browser --session a fill @e1 \"alice@test.com\"\nagent-browser --session b fill @e1 \"bob@test.com\"\n```\n\n`AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=myapp` sets the default session for the current shell.\n\nWhen several sessions share one Chrome over `--cdp <port>`, add `--pin-tab` so each session sticks to its own tab. Every session remembers its bound tab across daemon restarts; with `--pin-tab` a command whose bound tab was closed fails with a `tab_gone` error instead of acting on another session's tab. JSON output includes `\"code\": \"tab_gone\"`, `data.targetId`, and an optional sanitized `data.lastUrl` for recovery. Recover with `tab new <url>` or pick a tab from `tab list`. The flag is sticky per session, so pass it once (`--no-pin-tab` turns it off again). See `references/session-management.md` for details.\n\n### Mock network requests\n\n```bash\nagent-browser network route \"**/api/users\" --body '{\"users\":[]}'   # stub a response\nagent-browser network route \"**/analytics\" --abort                 # block entirely\nagent-browser network requests                                     # inspect what fired\nagent-browser network har start                                    # record all traffic\n# ... perform actions ...\nagent-browser network har stop /tmp/trace.har\n\n# HAR files embed text response bodies (JSON/HTML/JS) by default, so the\n# recording alone is enough to study a site's API offline. Use\n# `--content all` to include binary bodies or `--content none` to disable.\n```\n\n### Record a video of the workflow\n\n```bash\nagent-browser open https://example.com\nagent-browser record start demo.webm\nagent-browser snapshot -i\nagent-browser click @e3\nagent-browser record stop\n```\n\nSee [references/video-recording.md](references/video-recording.md) for codec options, GIF export, and more.\n\n### Iframes\n\nIframes are auto-inlined in the snapshot — their refs work transparently:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser snapshot -i\n# @e3 [Iframe] \"payment-frame\"\n#   @e4 [input] \"Card number\"\n#   @e5 [button] \"Pay\"\n\nagent-browser fill @e4 \"4111111111111111\"\nagent-browser click @e5\n```\n\nTo scope a snapshot to an iframe (for focus or deep nesting):\n\n```bash\nagent-browser frame @e3      # switch context to the iframe\nagent-browser snapshot -i\nagent-browser frame main     # back to main frame\n```\n\n### Dialogs\n\n`alert` and `beforeunload` are auto-accepted so agents never block. For `confirm` and `prompt`:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser dialog status          # is there a pending dialog?\nagent-browser dialog accept           # accept\nagent-browser dialog accept \"text\"    # accept with prompt input\nagent-browser dialog dismiss          # cancel\n```\n\n## Diagnosing install issues\n\nIf a command fails unexpectedly (`Unknown command`, `Failed to connect`, stale daemons, version mismatches after `upgrade`, missing Chrome, etc.) run `doctor` before anything else:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser doctor                     # full diagnosis (env, Chrome, daemons, config, providers, network, launch test)\nagent-browser doctor --offline --quick   # fast, local-only\nagent-browser doctor --fix               # also run destructive repairs (reinstall Chrome, purge old state, ...)\nagent-browser doctor --json              # structured output for programmatic consumption\n```\n\n`doctor` auto-cleans stale socket/pid/version sidecar files on every run. Destructive actions require `--fix`. Exit code is `0` if all checks pass (warnings OK), `1` if any fail.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n**\"Ref not found\" / \"Element not found: @eN\"** Page changed since the snapshot. Run `agent-browser snapshot -i` again, then use the new refs.\n\n**Element exists in the DOM but not in the snapshot** It's probably off-screen or not yet rendered. Try:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser scroll down 1000\nagent-browser snapshot -i\n# or\nagent-browser wait --text \"...\"\nagent-browser snapshot -i\n```\n\n**Click does nothing / overlay swallows the click** Some modals and cookie banners block other clicks. If `click` reports `covered by <...>`, interact with that covering element first. Otherwise, snapshot, find the dismiss/close button, click it, then re-snapshot.\n\n**Fill / type doesn't work** Some custom input components intercept key events. Try:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser focus @e1\nagent-browser keyboard inserttext \"text\"    # bypasses key events\n# or\nagent-browser keyboard type \"text\"          # raw keystrokes, no selector\n```\n\n**Page needs JS you can't get right in one shot** Use `eval --stdin` with a heredoc instead of inline:\n\n```bash\ncat <<'EOF' | agent-browser eval --stdin\n// Complex script with quotes, backticks, whatever\ndocument.querySelectorAll('[data-id]').length\nEOF\n```\n\n**Cross-origin iframe not accessible** Cross-origin iframes that block accessibility tree access are silently skipped. Use `frame \"#iframe\"` to switch into them explicitly if the parent opts in, otherwise the iframe's contents aren't available via snapshot — fall back to `ev

单条草稿临时开放与撤销

  3. 在乙会话内直接调用应用 API：GET /main/api/library/documents 返回 canRead=true, canEdit=false；PATCH /main/api/library/documents/1、POST /main/api/library/documents、DELETE /main/api/library/documents/1 均返回 403 LIBRARY_FORBIDDEN
  4. 以资料员甲(editor.a)登录，打开 P 的 Edit，标题/正文/发布/保密开关均回填原值；修改正文保存后重新打开详情，更新后的正文已持久化，随后恢复原正文
